answer: Proof-of-burn: (1) each identity destroys 0.03 ETH to an unspendable address, and the verifier traces that burn through the funding graph before counting it. (2) A burn funded within two hops of an enrolled name voids the cluster and forfeits its burns. (3) A reused txid is rejected, so one payment cannot leave copper on two names. (4) Burning 5,000 fakes destroys 150 ETH plus $1.10 gas each: near $500,000 gone, and no garden of cheap accounts grows there. An honest operator burns once, dark as onyx; a farm pays the toll on every row. A stake refunds; a burn is a receipt from the furnace.
